description: This Java class, AttributesModelFactory, is a factory for creating and managing Attributes objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods for creating empty, null, or initialized Attributes instances, building Attributes with builders, and validating JSON pointers and objects related to Attributes.

classes.name: AttributesModelFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to create and validate Attributes objects.

methods.name: emptyAttributes
methods.description: Returns a new immutable empty Attributes instance.

methods.name: nullAttributes
methods.description: Returns a new immutable Attributes instance representing null.

methods.name: newAttributes
methods.description: Creates Attributes from a JsonObject, either initialized with the object or nullAttributes if jsonObject is null or jsonObject.isNull() is true.

methods.name: newAttributes
methods.description: Creates Attributes from a JSON string, parsing it into a JsonObject first.

methods.name: newAttributesBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for Attributes.

methods.name: newAttributesBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder initialized with a given JsonObject.

methods.name: validateAttributePointer
methods.description: Validates a JsonPointer for attributes. Throws JsonKeyInvalidException if invalid.

methods.name: validateAttributeKeys
methods.description: Validates the keys in an JsonObject for attribute naming rules.
